exposure: immersion in water for pain relief
birth in a freestanding midwifery unit (FMU)
birth in an alongside midwifery unit (AMU)
outcome: Chance of a straightforward vaginal birth
cohort: 16,577 low-risk nulliparous women planning birth at home, in a freestanding midwifery unit (FMU), or in an alongside midwifery unit (AMU) in England
finding: Immersion in water for pain relief during labor was associated with a significant reduction in the risk of transfer before birth for nulliparous women, and this effect varied across birth settings.
mod_finding: Immersion in water during labor was associated with a lower risk of transfer before birth for nulliparous women.
